column1: # Word budgets for harness markdown files, checked by tools/lint-harness.py.
# Format: <path from the repository root><TAB><word limit>. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Words = len(text.split()) in Python over the whole UTF-8 file (front matter, tables
# and code blocks included): runs of non-whitespace between whitespace, the same as
# `wc -w` in a UTF-8 locale. Under LC_ALL=C, `wc -w` does not split on Unicode spaces
# such as NBSP and may count fewer; the linter's count is the one that counts.
# Initial limits (v0.2, 2026-10-25): the count on that day rounded up to a multiple of 50.
# Every harness file (SKILL.md, agents/, core/, scenarios/, checklists/, evals/ outside
# evals/runs/, both in ru/ and in the root) needs a row; a row for a missing file is an error.
# Бюджеты слов для markdown-файлов харнесса; проверяет tools/lint-harness.py.
# Слова = len(text.split()) в Python по всему файлу (как `wc -w`). Начальные лимиты —
# число слов на 2026-10-25, округлённое вверх до кратного 50. Файл без строки — ошибка.
